title: Part 2: CSS
summary: Style your portfolio: colors, typography, layout and responsive design.
content:
# CSS Styling: Making Your Portfolio Look Sharp

CSS controls the presentation of your site. It turns plain HTML into a polished experience with spacing, color, layout, and motion.

## What To Focus On

### Visual Hierarchy
Use font sizes, weight, and spacing to make the most important content stand out first.

### Color System
- Pick 1 primary color for actions and accents
- Pick 1 or 2 neutral backgrounds
- Keep contrast strong enough for readability

### Layout Basics
- Use Flexbox for rows, navbars, and card groups
- Use Grid when you need a structured page layout
- Keep spacing consistent with a small scale

### Responsive Design
Your layout should still feel clean on phones, tablets, and desktop screens. Use media queries to adjust columns, spacing, and navigation.

## Your Task
Style the portfolio HTML so it feels modern and readable. Add spacing, typography, button states, and a responsive layout for the navbar and project cards.
